questions.q: Find the gradient of the line through (−1, 4) and (3, −4).
questions.why: Change in y ÷ change in x = (−4 − 4) ÷ (3 − (−1)) = −8 ÷ 4 = −2.

questions.q: Find the line perpendicular to y = 2x + 3 that passes through (4, 1).
questions.why: The perpendicular gradient is the negative reciprocal −½; 1 = −2 + c gives c = 3.
